owner_message: thêm luôn các ảnh reference mới tốt hơn cho bình phong đi rồi chạy thí nghiệm

entries.name: Bác Hồ ở chiến khu Việt Bắc
entries.description: This painting depicts a figure leading a donkey on a light-colored, rocky path, with dark green foliage and lighter, yellowish-brown sky or distant hills in the background. The figure, dressed in light brown, stands beside the donkey, which is also rendered in shades of brown and tan. The path occupies the lower half of the composition, featuring textured brushstrokes suggesting uneven terrain and rocks. The upper half is dominated by the dark green, densely painted foliage, with hints of lighter, warmer tones appearing through it, particularly towards the upper left. The overall color palette is earthy, with strong contrasts between the dark greens and the lighter browns and yellows.

entries.name: Bình phong
entries.description: This artwork is a multi-panel screen, likely a folding screen, depicting a dense, stylized jungle scene. The background is a dark, mottled green and brown, with hints of red and black foliage. Large, prominent leaves dominate the foreground, rendered in shades of white, cream, and light yellow with distinct brown or orange veins. Some leaves are a solid orange-brown. The composition features a variety of leaf shapes, from broad, heart-shaped leaves to elongated, banana-like forms. Smaller, darker leaves and red flowers are scattered throughout the upper and middle sections. The overall impression is one of lush, tropical vegetation with a strong contrast between the vibrant foreground elements and the darker background.

entries.name: Bình phong
entries.description: This multi-panel artwork, likely a screen, features a vibrant, stylized depiction of figures amidst lush foliage, rendered in a palette of greens, browns, golds, and whites. On the left, three women in patterned, long-sleeved garments stand together, one holding a basket of flowers, against a backdrop of large, golden-brown banana leaves and white blossoms. A crescent moon and clouds appear above them. Towards the center, a woman in a floral dress reclines on a patterned cushion, while another in a golden gown sits in a tree. Further right, two figures, one in a floral dress and another in a spotted garment, appear to be dancing or floating, with one holding a red flower. The background is filled with dense, dark green and brown foliage, with white roses scattered across the lower portion. The figures and flora are outlined and detailed with fine lines, suggesting an inlay or lacquer technique.

entries.name: Cánh cửa chạm rồng
entries.description: This is a large, rectangular wooden panel, likely a door or screen, composed of two vertical sections. The wood is a weathered, light gray-brown, showing visible grain and vertical seams. The entire surface is deeply carved with intricate, high-relief patterns. The design features two large, stylized dragons, one on each section, with their bodies winding through a dense arrangement of flame-like or cloud-like motifs and pointed, sword-like shapes. The dragons have detailed heads with open mouths and scales, and their limbs are visible amidst the swirling patterns. The carving creates a sense of depth and movement, with the various elements overlapping and intertwining.

entries.name: Em Thúy
entries.description: An oil painting depicts a young girl seated, facing forward, with her hands clasped in her lap. She has dark hair parted on the side, dark eyes, and light pink lips. She wears a short-sleeved, light-colored dress and a dark bracelet on her left wrist. The girl is seated in a dark brown wooden chair with a light brown backrest. The background is a textured mix of light yellow, red, and white, with abstract shapes. The bottom right corner of the painting contains the legible text "TRAN VAN CAN 1943".

entries.name: Gióng
entries.description: An abstract painting depicts a figure on horseback, rendered in a palette of muted yellows, creams, and grays against a textured reddish-orange background. The horse, in light gray, is stylized with angular, blocky forms, its head facing right with two dark circular eyes. The rider, also in light gray, has a rectangular face with two large circular eyes and a small mouth, wearing an elaborate, multi-layered headdress and costume adorned with geometric patterns, circles, and abstract motifs in yellow, orange, and red. A prominent red circle with a white outline is visible on the rider's chest. The lower left features a dark area with a small, light-colored fish-like object, and the bottom center includes a dark brown section with a red, stylized signature.

entries.name: Hai thiếu nữ và em bé
entries.description: This painting depicts three figures in an interior setting with a window revealing foliage. A woman in a long, flowing yellow dress sits on a raised platform, holding a pink object in her hands, her gaze directed slightly to the left. Another woman, dressed in a white long-sleeved garment, kneels on the floor to the left, facing the first woman with her hands resting on her knees. A small child in a red shirt and white shorts kneels on the floor in the lower right, looking down at a red object. The background features a window with a bamboo blind at the top, showing green leaves and white flowers against a light blue-grey sky. The floor and platform are rendered in shades of brown and ochre. The visible text in the bottom right corner reads "TÔ NGỌC VÂN 46".

entries.name: Hoàng hậu Ngọc Trúc
entries.description: A seated, full-body statue of a figure with light-colored skin, wearing an elaborate crown and robes, is positioned centrally on a dark red rectangular base. The figure's face is serene, with downcast eyes and a slight smile. The crown is dark with gold accents and features a small, golden seated figure at its center. The robes are predominantly dark red with intricate patterns and details in gold, blue, and green, including a heavily textured chest piece and long beaded necklaces. The figure's right hand is raised with fingers extended, while the left hand rests palm-up in the lap. The statue appears to be made of wood or a similar material, with visible cracks in the paint on the base.

entries.name: Kết nạp Đảng ở Điện Biên Phủ
entries.description: This painting depicts a group of eight male figures, likely soldiers, in various poses against a textured, earthy background of reddish-brown and beige. On the far left, one figure supports another, who appears to be injured or distressed, with his head resting on the first figure's shoulder. The central figures are mostly standing, some holding rifles, and one has a bandage wrapped around his head. They wear a mix of light-colored shirts, dark trousers or shorts, and some have helmets and military-style belts with pouches. The figures on the right are also standing, with one holding a rifle and another carrying a red flag or banner. The overall color palette is muted, dominated by browns, beiges, and dark blues, with visible brushstrokes creating a rough texture. In the bottom left corner, faint red lettering reads "MAI ANH HANOI-1961".

entries.name: Phật Bà Quan Âm
entries.description: A large, multi-armed, seated statue, predominantly red and dark brown with gold accents, is depicted. The central figure, with dark skin and a golden crown, sits cross-legged with hands pressed together in prayer. Numerous arms extend from its sides, each holding a small object or forming a gesture. The figure wears a red robe with dark brown folds. It rests on a lotus-petal base, which is supported by a tiered, ornate pedestal. The pedestal features carved figures, including two small standing figures on either side of the main statue, and grotesque faces and animal-like forms at its base. The entire structure shows signs of age and wear, with chipped paint and visible texture.

entries.name: Bác Hồ ở chiến khu Việt Bắc
entries.description: This painting depicts a landscape with a figure and a horse. The upper two-thirds of the canvas are dominated by dark green and black hues, forming what appears to be a dense forest or mountainous terrain, with patches of golden-yellow light breaking through in the upper left and right. The lower third of the painting is a lighter golden-yellow, textured to suggest rocky or uneven ground. On the right side of the lower section, a human figure in a hat stands next to a horse, both rendered in a lighter, almost glowing golden-yellow, contrasting with the dark background. The figures are somewhat indistinct, with soft edges and minimal detail. The overall impression is one of a dramatic, possibly twilight or dawn, scene.
entries.source_file: Bác Hồ ở chiến khu Việt Bắc/IMG_20261105_100638.jpg

entries.name: Bác Hồ ở chiến khu Việt Bắc
entries.description: An oil painting depicts a landscape with two figures in a dark brown wooden frame. The lower half of the painting shows a light brown, rocky terrain, while the upper half features dark green, heavily textured foliage on either side, forming a valley. In the center of the valley, a lighter brown, almost tan, sky is visible. Two light-colored, indistinct figures stand in the middle ground, embracing each other. The overall color palette is muted, dominated by browns, greens, and tans, with visible brushstrokes creating a textured surface.

entries.name: Bình phong
entries.description: This is a large, multi-panel artwork featuring a dense, stylized jungle scene against a dark, almost black background. Large, textured leaves dominate the composition, rendered in shades of cream, gold, and brown with prominent red or dark brown veins. Some leaves have a cracked or distressed appearance. Interspersed among the foliage are smaller, solid red leaves and flowers, as well as dark, silhouetted plant forms. In the upper left, a cluster of red bamboo-like leaves is visible, and several small, red birds are depicted in flight or perched. The overall impression is one of lush, exotic vegetation with a rich, somewhat muted color palette.

entries.name: Cánh cửa chạm rồng
entries.description: This is a large, rectangular wooden panel, likely a door or screen, composed of two vertical sections. It is heavily carved in high relief with intricate, swirling patterns and figures. The dominant motifs appear to be dragons or serpentine creatures, their bodies intertwined with flame-like or cloud-like tendrils and numerous vertical, pointed shapes resembling blades or stylized mountains. The carving covers almost the entire surface, creating a dense, textured composition. The wood is a muted, dark brown or greyish-brown, showing signs of age and wear, with visible cracks and grain. A faint, circular lighter area is visible near the center where the two panels meet.

entries.name: Em Thúy
entries.description: A framed portrait painting depicts a young girl seated, facing forward with a direct gaze. She has dark hair pulled back, with some strands framing her face, and wears a light-colored, possibly white or pale pink, short-sleeved dress. Her hands are clasped in her lap, and a dark bracelet adorns her left wrist. She is seated in a chair with a visible curved backrest, rendered in shades of brown. The background is a warm yellow-gold, with abstract shapes and hints of white and reddish-orange, possibly flowers or patterns, on the right side. The painting is housed in a thick, light brown wooden frame with multiple carved ridges. Faint, dark lettering is visible in the bottom right corner of the painting.

entries.name: Gióng
entries.description: This abstract painting, framed in dark wood, depicts a stylized figure on horseback against an orange-brown background. The central figures are composed of geometric shapes and lines in muted tones of grey, beige, yellow, and pale blue. The rider, with a blocky head and two dark eyes, wears an elaborate headdress and patterned clothing, holding a long, horizontal object. The horse, facing right, is rendered with a simplified head and striped body. Red and dark brown shapes are interspersed throughout the composition, particularly behind the horse and beneath the rider. A faint signature, "Marcos," is visible in the lower center.

entries.name: Gióng
entries.description: An abstract painting depicts a figure on horseback, rendered in a cubist style with geometric shapes and muted colors. The background is a warm, reddish-brown, with faint circular patterns. The horse, predominantly light gray, is shown in profile, with a blocky head and two dark, circular eyes. The rider, also composed of geometric forms in shades of gray, yellow, and green, wears an elaborate headdress with gold accents and has two prominent circular eyes. Various patterns and smaller shapes, including circles and rectangles, adorn both the rider and the horse. A dark, reddish-brown area grounds the figures at the bottom, where a signature "M. S. 1949" is visible.

entries.name: Gióng
entries.description: An abstract painting, framed in dark wood, depicts a stylized horse and rider in muted tones of beige, grey, and pale yellow against an orange-red background. The horse, on the right, is rendered with angular shapes, its head facing right with a red mane. The rider, positioned centrally, is composed of geometric forms and patterns, including a prominent red circle with a white center on the chest and several white ovals above. Green and dark blue shapes are visible on the left side of the rider. The overall composition suggests movement, with the horse's legs extended as if galloping.

entries.name: Hai thiếu nữ và em bé
entries.description: This painting depicts three figures in an interior setting with a window revealing foliage. A woman in a long, flowing yellow dress sits on a light-colored bench or cushion on the right, holding a pink flower. To her left, another woman in a white long-sleeved garment kneels on the floor, looking towards the seated woman. A small child, wearing a red top and white bottom, crouches on the floor in the lower right, seemingly playing. The background features a window with a bamboo blind at the top, and outside, a plant with green leaves and light pink flowers is visible against a light blue sky. The overall color palette is soft, with warm yellows and browns on the floor and cool greens and blues in the background.
entries.source_file: Hai thiếu nữ và em bé/IMG_20261105_100349.jpg

entries.name: Hai thiếu nữ và em bé
entries.description: This painting depicts three figures in a domestic setting. A woman in a long, flowing yellow dress sits on a white bench, holding a pink object in her hands. To her left, a younger girl in a white dress kneels on the ground, looking towards the woman. Both have dark hair pulled back, with the girl having a pink flower in her hair. In the lower right, a small child in a red and white top crouches on the ground, playing with a red object. Behind the figures, a wall with a window reveals a plant with green leaves and numerous light pink flowers. A woven bamboo blind hangs above the window. The overall color palette is soft, with warm browns, greens, and pastel pinks.

entries.name: Hoàng hậu Ngọc Trúc
entries.description: A seated, light-skinned figure with a serene expression wears a dark red, ornate robe with gold accents and a blue shawl. The figure's right hand is raised with fingers extended, while the left hand rests in its lap. A long, beaded necklace hangs from the neck, and a dark, intricately carved crown with a golden, flame-like halo containing a small, seated golden figure adorns the head. The figure sits cross-legged on a dark red, octagonal base.

entries.name: Kết nạp Đảng ở Điện Biên Phủ
entries.description: An oil painting depicts seven male figures in military attire, rendered in a muted palette of browns, tans, and dark greens. The figures, some wearing helmets or caps, are arranged in a loose group, with several holding rifles. Their faces are indistinct, and their bodies are depicted with a somewhat blocky, textured style. The background is a textured blend of reddish-brown and golden-tan, suggesting an outdoor, possibly rugged, environment. The overall composition is horizontal, with the figures filling most of the frame.
entries.source_file: Kết nạp Đảng ở Điện Biên Phủ/IMG_1589.HEIC

entries.name: Kết nạp Đảng ở Điện Biên Phủ
entries.description: This painting depicts a group of seven figures, likely soldiers, in a warm-toned, textured landscape. The figures are rendered with a rough, almost mosaic-like texture, particularly noticeable in their lighter-colored clothing and helmets. On the left, two figures appear to be supporting each other, one with an arm around the other's shoulder. The central figures are standing, some holding rifles, and are equipped with various pouches and gear. Their attire consists of dark trousers, brown boots, and lighter-colored shirts or jackets, with some wearing helmets. The background is a blend of earthy browns and yellows, with a lighter, more textured area in the upper right suggesting a sky or distant light source. The overall palette is muted, dominated by browns, ochres, and dark greens.
entries.source_file: Kết nạp Đảng ở Điện Biên Phủ/IMG_20261105_100851.jpg

entries.name: Phật Bà Quan Âm
entries.description: A multi-armed, seated figure with dark skin and a golden crown is depicted in this wooden sculpture, which is predominantly reddish-brown with some black and gold accents. The main figure sits cross-legged, with two hands pressed together in prayer at the chest, and numerous other arms fanning out from its sides, each holding a small object or making a gesture. The figure wears flowing robes and a detailed, ornate crown. It rests on a large, tiered pedestal adorned with carved lotus petals, mythical creatures, and geometric patterns. Two smaller, standing figures with light skin and red robes flank the main figure on the lotus base. The entire sculpture shows signs of age, with chipped paint and worn surfaces.

entries.name: Phật Bà Quan Âm
entries.description: A large, multi-armed statue of a seated figure dominates the image, rendered in dark, reddish-brown material with hints of gold on the face and elaborate headdress. The main figure sits cross-legged, with numerous arms fanning out from its torso, each hand in a distinct gesture or holding a small object. It wears draped robes, with a smaller, standing figure in lighter tones positioned in front of its lap. The main figure rests on a large, ornate pedestal with a bowl-like top featuring carved lotus petal patterns. This bowl is supported by four smaller figures, and the entire structure sits on a multi-tiered base adorned with intricate relief carvings and geometric patterns. To the right, a smaller, standing figure on a decorative stand is visible.

entries.name: Phật Bà Quan Âm
entries.description: A multi-armed, dark-skinned deity with a golden crown and facial accents sits cross-legged, hands clasped in prayer at the chest. The figure wears a reddish-brown robe, revealing a smaller figure on its belly. Numerous arms extend from its sides, holding various small objects. The deity rests on a reddish-brown, lotus-shaped pedestal with carved petals, supported by smaller figures and ornate scrollwork. This pedestal sits on a multi-tiered, rectangular base with carved patterns and red-orange panels. Two small, light-skinned figures, one in a red robe, stand on either side of the lotus pedestal.

entries.name: Bình phong
entries.description: This large, rectangular painting depicts a vibrant outdoor scene with multiple figures and lush foliage. On the left, three women in long, patterned dresses stand together, one holding a bouquet of white flowers. A fourth woman in a floral dress reclines on the ground below them, near a rose bush with white blossoms. To the right, another woman in a flowing yellow and red dress sits amidst dark green and brown trees, while two more figures, one in a patterned brown dress and another in a grey top and red skirt, appear to be dancing or interacting in the upper right. The background features a pale moon and hints of clouds against a muted, earthy sky, with various plants and trees in shades of green, brown, and red filling the composition.

entries.name: Hoàng hậu Ngọc Trúc
entries.description: A seated, light-skinned figure with a dark, ornate headdress and robes is depicted in a side profile, facing left. The figure's right hand is raised with fingers extended, while the left hand rests in its lap. A dark, beaded necklace hangs around its neck. The robes are a deep reddish-brown with textured, possibly embroidered, patterns on the shoulders and chest, and the figure sits on a dark, multi-tiered base. The overall impression is of a solemn, richly adorned statue.

entries.name: Hoàng hậu Ngọc Trúc
entries.description: A seated statue, viewed from the back, depicts a figure with light-colored skin, wearing an elaborate, dark-colored crown with a tall, carved finial. The figure's hair is dark, with two light-colored ribbons hanging down the back. The garment is primarily dark red and dark blue, with textured, possibly embroidered, patterns in gold and lighter shades. The shoulders feature a raised, textured pattern, while the sleeves and lower back of the robe have gold circular motifs and stylized cloud or wave patterns. The figure is seated on a dark red, rectangular base.

entries.name: Hoàng hậu Ngọc Trúc
entries.description: A seated, light-skinned figure with a dark, ornate headdress and robes is visible from the chest up, facing right in profile. The figure's right hand is raised with the palm facing forward and fingers extended upwards. The robes are dark brown with textured patterns, and a lighter, possibly golden, sash or braid hangs down the back. The headdress is complex, featuring a tall, dark, pointed element at the top and lighter, possibly metallic, bands around the forehead. The figure is displayed on a dark, reddish-brown rectangular base.

entries.name: Bình phong
entries.description: A large, multi-panel artwork, possibly a screen or folding partition, displays a vibrant botanical scene against a dark, mottled background. The composition features numerous large leaves, predominantly in shades of cream and white with reddish-brown veins and outlines, creating a striking contrast. Interspersed among these are solid reddish-orange leaves and flowers, along with darker, silhouetted foliage. The overall impression is one of lush, dense vegetation. The artwork is framed by a thin, dark border and stands on a light gray base. In the background, another framed artwork with a figure in a patterned garment against a reddish-brown background is partially visible.

entries.name: Bình phong
entries.description: A large, multi-panel artwork, possibly a screen or mural, depicts a dense, stylized jungle scene against a dark gray background. Large, prominent leaves with white and light orange veins dominate the foreground, some with solid reddish-brown undersides. Other leaves are dark green or black, blending into the background. Scattered among the foliage are smaller, reddish-pink leaves and flowers, and a dark brown bird is visible in the upper left. The artwork is framed in a dark border and stands on a gray base.

addition_scope: Two leaf-side oblique camera views only. Figure-side candidates excluded: introduce wrong-artifact accepts. All previous30 reference bytes/vectors retained. Modality/policy unchanged.
